scope: Static read-only workflow/entry-point review; no remote CI success claim, no repeat render and no duplicated family parser review.

checks.name: uses committed manifest validate, not manifest audit or template create
Python fixtures only write within TemporaryDirectory; manifest build in unit setup is in memory
native probe only writes supplied temporary JSON and sibling reopened reference scene
map prepare requires a fresh outside-checkout output; source GLB symlink remains read-only to tests
Unit and validation failures return nonzero; native probe exits 1 on failed checks and 2 on setup/output errors; map exits 1 on failures; the 45-second timeout returns nonzero.
GitHub default bash fail-fast propagates direct command exits, without masking or continue-on-error
if always artifact archive includes hero probe JSON, map report JSON and map source manifest JSON

limits: Commands write temporary evidence and Godot import caches; canonical assets are not regenerated.
No standalone CPU/GPU render, animation aesthetic, whole hero/map or game completion credit.
Python test count is 20 in current source; discover runs all matching tests, so no workflow change is needed if an earlier narrative says 17.
Family adverse-source findings are reviewed independently by the root family reviewer; this static workflow review does not replace that gate.
